result.title: Simplify document access helper
result.body: read_document(documents, doc_id, user_id): existing documents are dictionaries; only their owner may read the body; others get PermissionError.
result.author: fixture-author

result.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def read_document(documents, doc_id, user_id):
     document = documents[doc_id]
-    if document['owner_id'] == user_id:
-        return document['body']
-    raise PermissionError('Access denied')
+    if document['owner_id'] != user_id:
+        raise PermissionError('Access denied')
+    return document['body']
